findings.title: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets
findings.key_insight: RNN with Monte Carlo dropout yields calibrated sequential probabilities. MC dropout at inference time provides uncertainty estimates without a separate calibration step. Brier ~0.221.
findings.applicability: HIGH — MC dropout or isotonic calibration wrapper around our best tree ensemble could close remaining gap
findings.implementation: In evaluate_individual(): after model.predict_proba(), apply CalibratedClassifierCV(method='isotonic', cv=3) — already documented in carryover, expected -0.005 Brier

findings.title: Integration of XGBoost and SHAP for NBA Game Outcome Prediction
findings.key_insight: Top-3 features across all tested models: home_next (next game home/away indicator), team_elo_5_y (5-year rolling ELO), team_elo (current ELO). These dominate SHAP importance in every model type tested. Achieves Brier ~0.20.
findings.applicability: HIGH — verify these 3 feature types are in features/engine.py; ELO is the single highest-value feature to add if missing
findings.implementation: grep -i 'elo' features/engine.py. If absent: add rolling Elo calculation (K=20, home_advantage=100) updated each game result — ~50 LOC addition to engine

findings.title: Comparing Machine Learning Methods for NBA Game Outcome Prediction
findings.key_insight: CNN over rolling 10-game form windows achieves Brier 0.221, competitive with our fleet best. Captures sequential momentum effects that static features miss.
findings.applicability: MEDIUM — requires GPU (Conv layers). Could be implemented as Colab/Modal burst experiment.
findings.implementation: Script: 10-game rolling window → Conv1D(32) → Dense(16) → sigmoid. Run on Modal A10G burst.

findings.title: Stacked Ensemble Model for NBA Game Outcome Prediction
findings.key_insight: Stacked ensemble (XGBoost + RF + LogReg meta-learner) outperforms any single model. On CPU islands stacking is disabled (too slow) — but shallow 2-model stack via Colab shows measurable gains.
findings.applicability: LOW for CPU islands (disabled); HIGH for Colab experiments. In TabICL pipeline: stack TabICL + XGBoost oof predictions as meta-features.
findings.implementation: Colab: generate OOF predictions from TabICL + XGBoost separately → LightGBM meta-learner on stacked preds

findings.implementation: Browse top-10 public kernels for feature engineering patterns transferable to our engine
